subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is Lin Jing from <Picture 1>. Preserve her exact facial identity, mature age appearance, hairstyle, realistic skin texture, body proportions, and locked home wardrobe.

<Subject 2> is Zhang Guilan from <Picture 2>. Preserve her exact facial identity, elderly age appearance, hairstyle, realistic skin texture, body proportions, and locked EP01 wardrobe.

<Subject 3> is Zhou Jianming from <Picture 3>. Preserve his exact facial identity, age, hairstyle, realistic skin texture, body proportions, and locked EP01 wardrobe.

<Subject 4> is Aying from <Picture 4>. Preserve her exact facial identity, hairstyle, realistic skin texture, body proportions, locked wardrobe, and established pregnant condition. She remains vocally silent throughout this unit.

<Subject 5> is the property-ownership document from <Picture 8>. Preserve its exact physical official-document appearance, paper proportions, and material state. Fine printed text does not need to become legible.

<Picture 5> controls only Lin Jing-side environment appearance, lighting, spatial perspective, camera direction, and framing.

<Picture 6> controls only the sofa-group environment, sofa geometry, lighting, spatial perspective, camera direction, and framing.

<Picture 7> is the authoritative spatial blocking and staging reference. It controls fixed furniture positions, relative distances, body orientations, gaze-line geometry, and screen direction.

For this unit, <Subject 1> Lin Jing is already standing beside the near-left edge of the coffee table. She begins with <Subject 5> held steadily at lower-chest height and angled toward the sofa group.

<Subject 2> Zhang Guilan begins seated at the established far-right sofa position. Her attention is already fixed on the newly revealed document.

<Subject 3> Zhou Jianming begins seated at the established left-side sofa position. A small ordinary metal keyring remains visible low in his right hand near his thigh. His attention is already fixed on <Subject 5>.

<Subject 4> Aying remains seated at the established middle-right sofa position, with one hand resting naturally near her abdomen. Her previous relaxed smile has already stopped.

<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre and delivery reference for <Subject 1> (S1), Lin Jing. Audio mode: audio reference. Retention: reference. Use it only to preserve her locked voice identity, timbre, resonance, articulation, habitual cadence, and breath behavior. Do not copy its source transcript, ambience, music, or noise.

<Audio 2> is the voice-timbre and delivery reference for <Subject 2> (S2), Zhang Guilan. Audio mode: audio reference. Retention: reference. Use it only to preserve her locked voice identity, timbre, resonance, articulation, habitual cadence, and breath behavior. Do not copy its source transcript, ambience, music, or noise.

<Audio 3> is the voice-timbre and delivery reference for <Subject 3> (S3), Zhou Jianming. Audio mode: audio reference. Retention: reference. Use it only to preserve his locked voice identity, timbre, resonance, articulation, habitual cadence, and breath behavior. Do not copy its source transcript, ambience, music, or noise.


summary:

[reference generation + audio reference]

Create a vertical 9:16 realistic live-action short-drama scene in the established nighttime living room.

Lin Jing immediately reveals the first decisive ownership fact. Zhang Guilan's confidence breaks into a rapid physical and verbal challenge. Lin Jing shuts that challenge down without increasing her volume or changing her physical composure. The sofa group loses its previous certainty for only a brief moment. Zhou Jianming is visibly hit by the setback, suppresses that reaction almost immediately, and forces himself back into control by introducing another source of power.

The rhythm is: factual reveal → explosive denial → factual shutdown → brief group imbalance → rapid emotional suppression → immediate counterattack.

Fast short-drama pacing.

Do not allow the defeated reaction to linger.

Only the current speaker performs full lip articulation.

No spoken dialogue text is repeated outside its owning timed <d> event.

No subtitles, captions, translation text, visible dialogue text, titles, or speech bubbles.


retention_analysis:

<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - preserve Lin Jing's exact identity, wardrobe, coffee-table-side standing position, property-document hold, and calm physical control. Allow only explicitly described gaze, eyelid, facial, document, and vocal performance.

<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - preserve Zhang Guilan's exact identity, wardrobe, and seated opening position. Allow the explicitly described rapid stand, facial escalation, claiming gesture, and vocal performance. After her challenge is shut down, keep her lips fully closed.

<Subject 3>: fully_preserved - preserve Zhou Jianming's exact identity, wardrobe, left-side sofa position, keyring state, and spatial relationship to Lin Jing. Allow the explicitly described brief destabilization, suppression of that reaction, posture recovery, and vocal counterattack.

<Subject 4>: fully_preserved - preserve Aying's exact identity, wardrobe, pregnancy, middle-right sofa position, and hand position near her abdomen. Silent reaction only.

<Subject 5>: fully_preserved - preserve the property document continuously in Lin Jing's hand. Do not duplicate, replace, distort, or transform it.

<Picture 5>: fully_preserved for Lin Jing-side environment, lighting, camera direction, and depth only.

<Picture 6>: fully_preserved for sofa-group environment, furniture geometry, lighting, camera direction, and depth only.

<Picture 7>: fully_preserved as the authoritative spatial-coordinate and blocking reference, with only Lin Jing's already-established current standing position replacing her original marker.

<Picture 8>: fully_preserved as the physical reference for the property-ownership document.

<Audio 1>: reference - Lin Jing / S1 only.

<Audio 2>: reference - Zhang Guilan / S2 only.

<Audio 3>: reference - Zhou Jianming / S3 only.


detailed_description:

REFERENCE PRIORITY AND CONTINUITY:

Character LOOK references control identity, age appearance, body appearance, and wardrobe.

Environment VIEW references control room appearance, lighting, spatial perspective, camera direction, and composition.

<Picture 7> controls spatial blocking, relative distance, body orientation, eyelines, and furniture relationships.

<Picture 8> controls only the physical appearance of the property-ownership document.

Do not let LOOK references override spatial staging.

Do not let <Picture 7> redefine facial identity or wardrobe.

All fixed furniture remains stationary.

Only explicitly described actions may change posture, gaze, hand position, or prop state.

No character looks directly into the camera lens.

Preserve the interpersonal eyeline geometry defined by <Picture 7>.


BACKGROUND PERFORMANCE:

Only the current speaker performs full speech articulation.

All non-speaking visible characters keep their lips naturally closed.

They continue natural breathing and may make only the explicitly described gaze, facial, head, posture, or hand reactions.

No silent character mouths another character's words.

No off-screen or background character produces improvised dialogue, filler speech, laughter, sighs, gasps, humming, or other vocal reactions.


TEXT RENDERING HARD RULE:

Do not render spoken language as subtitles or on-screen dialogue text.

Do not create translation text, captions, titles, speech bubbles, or karaoke-style text.

The property document may be clearly visible as a physical object, but its fine printed text does not need to become legible.


VIDEO AND CAMERA:

9:16 vertical frame.

Realistic live-action short-drama photography.

Natural nighttime indoor lighting.

Realistic skin texture, hair detail, and fabric texture.

Fast pressure-driven pacing.

Strong and immediately readable reactions.

No decorative slow push-in.

No unnecessary camera drift.

No orbiting camera.

Every hard cut must add information, transfer power, or show the immediate consequence of the preceding line.


[Shot 1]

00:00.000–00:02.100

Use <Picture 5> for environment and camera direction.

55mm medium-close framing on Lin Jing.

Camera approximately at standing eye level and 25 degrees off her frontal axis.

<Subject 5> is already held steadily at lower-chest height, angled toward the sofa group.

00:00.000–00:00.200:

Lin Jing is already looking toward the sofa group.

Her shoulders remain relaxed.

Her chin stays level.

Her grip on <Subject 5> is stable.

Her mouth remains neutral.

00:00.200–00:00.350:

Her gaze settles directly on Zhou Jianming for a brief beat.

Her lips part naturally.

00:00.350–00:01.850:

<Subject 1> (S1), using <Audio 1> only as the locked voice-timbre and delivery reference, speaks with crisp factual certainty and normal conversational volume; the premarital timing receives mild emphasis, while the full-payment fact lands firmly downward with no triumph or anger:

<d>[Chinese] 这套房子。我结婚前全款买的。</d>

Near the final factual phrase, she lifts <Subject 5> only a few centimeters once and immediately holds it steady again.

Her brows remain calm.

Her face stays factual rather than confrontational.

00:01.850–00:02.100:

Her lips close.

The document remains steady.

Her gaze stays toward the sofa group.


[Shot 2] At 00:02.100, HARD CUT.

00:02.100–00:04.150

Use <Picture 6> for environment and camera direction.

50mm medium framing on Zhang Guilan, wide enough to show the complete standing action.

00:02.100–00:02.300:

The information lands.

Zhang Guilan's eyes widen immediately.

Her brows jump upward.

The previous confident mouth shape disappears.

Her attention snaps to the document.

00:02.300–00:02.500:

Her near-side palm drives firmly into the sofa cushion.

Her torso pitches forward.

Her weight transfers rapidly onto both feet.

She is already beginning to rise.

00:02.500–00:03.950:

<Subject 2> (S2), using <Audio 2> only as the locked voice-timbre and delivery reference, bursts into immediate sharp disbelief while physically rising, then turns that disbelief into an offended possessive claim; the opening strike is fast and forceful, while the family-ownership phrase receives stronger emphasis without becoming uncontrolled shouting:

<d>[Chinese] 不可能！这是我儿子的家！</d>

The first exclamation begins while her body is already leaving the sofa.

By the start of the second sentence, her hips are fully clear of the cushion.

By the possessive phrase, she reaches full standing height.

Her free hand makes one short downward claiming gesture toward the room.

00:03.950–00:04.150:

Her lips close.

She remains fully standing.

Her chest stays slightly forward.

Her eyes lock directly onto Lin Jing.

The claiming hand stops rather than continuing to wave.


[Shot 3] At 00:04.150, HARD CUT.

00:04.150–00:05.950

Use <Picture 5> for environment and camera direction.

65mm tight medium-close framing on Lin Jing.

00:04.150–00:04.450:

Lin Jing receives Zhang Guilan's outburst without stepping backward.

Her shoulders remain loose.

Her chin remains level.

Her grip on the property document does not change.

Her eyes stay directly on Zhang Guilan.

00:04.450–00:04.600:

Her gaze remains completely steady.

There is no need to re-check the document.

Her lips part.

00:04.600–00:05.750:

<Subject 1> (S1), using <Audio 1> only as the same locked voice-timbre and delivery reference, speaks even more calmly than before, giving restrained emphasis to exclusivity and the strongest semantic weight to her legal ownership; the ending closes decisively downward:

<d>[Chinese] 房本上只有我的名字。</d>

She makes no additional document gesture.

Her eyes remain directly on Zhang Guilan for the entire vocal event.

00:05.750–00:05.950:

Her lips close.

Her gaze remains steady.

No smile.

No nod.

No victory gesture.


[Shot 4] At 00:05.950, HARD CUT.

00:05.950–00:06.950

Use <Picture 6> for compact sofa-group reaction coverage.

55mm reaction framing.

00:05.950–00:06.250:

Zhang Guilan's forward aggression stops immediately.

The hand that had just claimed the room loses its force and lowers slightly.

Her lips press firmly closed.

Her eyes remain fixed on Lin Jing and the document.

She stays standing but no longer advances.

00:06.250–00:06.500:

Aying's eyes drop rapidly to the property document.

The previous comfortable expression disappears.

Her smile stops completely.

Her hand near her abdomen becomes still.

00:06.500–00:06.700:

Aying's gaze immediately shifts from the document toward Zhou Jianming.

Her lips stay closed.

The reaction is quick and contained.

00:06.700–00:06.950:

Zhou Jianming's eyes remain on the document for a short beat.

His brows draw inward.

His jaw tightens visibly once.

The keyring in his right hand becomes completely still.

His posture starts becoming more upright.

The setback has landed, but he is already suppressing the reaction.


[Shot 5] At 00:06.950, HARD CUT.

00:06.950–00:09.150

Use <Picture 6> for environment and camera direction.

60–65mm medium-close framing on Zhou Jianming.

Camera approximately at seated eye level and 25–30 degrees off frontal.

00:06.950–00:07.250:

Zhou Jianming remains fixed on the property document for only a brief moment.

The tension in his jaw shows that the house revelation has hit him.

He does not allow that reaction to linger.

00:07.250–00:07.450:

His eyes snap back up to Lin Jing.

His upper body straightens.

His chin rises slightly.

The vulnerable hesitation is actively covered by a harder expression.

The keyring remains low and irrelevant near his thigh.

00:07.450–00:07.550:

His lips part immediately.

00:07.550–00:09.050:

<Subject 3> (S3), using <Audio 3> only as the locked voice-timbre and delivery reference, counters quickly after suppressing the setback: the opening phrase deliberately minimizes the loss with forced dismissiveness, while the final clause regains firmer confidence and receives the clearest emphasis, as though he is immediately placing a stronger card on the table:

<d>[Chinese] 不就一套房子吗？我还有公司。</d>

During the opening phrase, his chin remains slightly raised.

By the final clause, his gaze is fully locked on Lin Jing and his posture has recovered deliberate authority.

He does not look toward Zhang Guilan or Aying for support.

00:09.050–00:09.150:

His lips close.

He remains upright.

His face shows that he believes he has successfully moved the confrontation onto safer ground.


[Shot 6] At 00:09.150, HARD CUT.

00:09.150–00:10.500

Use <Picture 5> for environment and camera direction.

65mm tight medium-close framing on Lin Jing.

00:09.150–00:09.450:

Lin Jing receives Zhou Jianming's counterattack.

Her eyes remain directly on him.

<Subject 5> stays steadily held at lower-chest height.

Her expression does not change into surprise.

00:09.450–00:09.650:

Her lower eyelids narrow by only a fraction.

Her breathing remains completely even.

Her jaw stays settled.

The visible response is immediate recognition, not concern.

00:09.650–00:10.500:

FINAL STATE:

Hold this exact state for the full final 0.85 seconds.

Lin Jing remains standing beside the coffee table.

<Subject 5> stays steadily held at lower-chest height.

Her gaze remains locked directly on Zhou Jianming.

Her face is calm, focused, and completely unshaken by his attempt to restore control.

Zhou Jianming remains seated upright at the left-side sofa position, watching her with deliberately recovered confidence.

The keyring remains low and still in his right hand.

Zhang Guilan remains standing at the far-right side of the sofa, lips closed and previous confidence visibly disrupted.

Aying remains seated at the middle-right sofa position, her smile gone and her hand still near her abdomen.

All non-speaking characters keep their lips naturally closed.

Natural breathing continues.

No new action or speech begins.


overall_soundscape:

<Audio 1> is used only for <Subject 1> (S1).

<Audio 2> is used only for <Subject 2> (S2).

<Audio 3> is used only for <Subject 3> (S3).

Never swap voice identities between characters.

Only the current speaker produces articulated human speech.

All other visible characters remain vocally silent during each vocal event.

Use very low natural indoor room tone.

Use one brief realistic sofa-compression sound during Zhang Guilan's rapid stand.

The keyring remains still and does not repeatedly jingle.

Use minimal natural clothing movement.

Do not invent filler words, off-screen speech, laughter, sighs, gasps, humming, background conversation, or additional vocal reactions.

Do not reuse or repeat any spoken dialogue from detailed_description.
